title: Re-Rated Ambulance Copay by Transportation Level of Service
content:
## Re-rated ambulance copay schedule

Under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, the re-rated copay of an ambulance transport under review follows the member's level of service on the Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit.

| Level of service | Re-rated ambulance copay per transport |
|---|---|
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 0.00 USD (stretcher transport copay) |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 5.00 USD (wheelchair transport copay) |
| RideLink Transit Pass, RideLink Mileage Reimbursement, RideLink Ambulatory Sedan, RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | The category's ambulance copay |

**Clause.** RideLink Stretcher Van re-rates at the stretcher transport copay of 0.00 USD, RideLink Wheelchair Van re-rates at the wheelchair transport copay of 5.00 USD, and any other level of service keeps the category's ambulance copay.

## Notes to the schedule

- The rate applies per ambulance transport under review, whatever the transport's date within the review.
- The rate is set by the level of service alone; the member's eligibility category matters only where the category's ambulance copay applies.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Two ambulance transports under review for a member on RideLink Wheelchair Van re-rate at 5.00 USD each, 10.00 USD for the two; for a member on RideLink Stretcher Van they re-rate at 0.00 USD.
